title: Role-Based Cover Letter Template
description: Domain-specific cover letter template strings used by the resume-machine correlator to generate per-job letter JSON files.

domain.description: Canonical domain identifier matching the resume template filename stem

opening_template.description: Opening sentence template. Supports {employer} and {job_title} placeholders.

intro.description: Optional fixed personal paragraph inserted between the opening and value proposition. Leave empty to omit.
